rows.reviewerFindingsJa: Removed later Kore/Levite relationship from always-visible identity note; it remains gated at 9:19. Wikipedia Shallum, lines 157–167 separates gatekeeper (9:17) from Levite porter (9:19,31); current secondary source is safe, though URL has no fragment and duplicated source records remain.
